# Keysi

Keysi is a macOS shortcut-learning app. Hold Command to see the frontmost
app's live menu shortcuts; the reference is free. Keysi Pro teaches shortcuts
you repeatedly reach for with the mouse through Coach reminders, Practice,
learning plans and progress.

## Product facts

- Platform: macOS 14 or later.
- Free: live shortcut overlay, searchable cheat sheets, no account or time
  limit.
- Pro: $14.99 one-time, 14-day trial, up to three Macs, no subscription.
- Distribution: signed/notarized direct download; licence checkout is Gumroad.
- Privacy: menu data stays on the Mac. Usage analytics are opt-in.
